name: OS-App Iteration Cycle 3 — Logger Cleanup, Test Expansion, Vendor Shrink
description: Migrate remaining 113 console.* calls to logger, expand test coverage to untested service directories, refactor VoiceManager, and lazy-load recharts.

userStories.title: Logger Migration — Services and UI
userStories.description: As a developer, I want remaining console.* calls in services/ and components/ migrated to logger.
acceptanceCriteria: services/capabilities/registry.ts: 7 console calls migrated to logger
Zero console.* in production services/ and components/ code
userStories.notes: All 6 remaining console calls migrated across 5 files. JSDoc/URL exemptions verified.

userStories.title: Logger Migration — Library Core Files
userStories.description: As a developer, I want console.* in lib core files (not examples) migrated.
acceptanceCriteria: cd libs/cpb-core && npm run build succeeds
cd libs/voice-nexus && npm run build succeeds
userStories.notes: All console calls in libs were inside JSDoc examples — exempt from migration.

userStories.title: Test Coverage — CPB and UI Services
userStories.description: As a developer, I want test coverage for CPB orchestrator and UI services.
acceptanceCriteria: CPB orchestrator tested: routing, execution, error paths
At least 10 new tests added across both directories

userStories.title: Test Coverage — Memory and Persistence
userStories.description: As a developer, I want test coverage for memory and persistence services.
acceptanceCriteria: MemoryStore tested: store, retrieve, search, clear operations
Persistence tested: save, load, migration paths

userStories.title: VoiceManager Refactor — Extract Modules
userStories.description: As a developer, I want VoiceManager (5272 lines) split into focused modules under 2000 lines.
acceptanceCriteria: Extracted modules placed in VoiceManager/parts/ or VoiceManager/ subdirectory
State management logic extracted to separate file
Command processing logic extracted to separate file
No behavioral changes — all voice features work identically
Existing VoiceManager tests in __tests__/index.test.ts still pass
userStories.notes: Deferred — 5272 lines requires multi-step refactor beyond single iteration scope.

userStories.title: Recharts Lazy Loading
userStories.description: As a developer, I want recharts (89KB gzip) lazy-loaded since charts aren't on first paint.
acceptanceCriteria: All components importing from recharts use React.lazy or dynamic import
vendor-recharts chunk no longer loaded on initial page load
Charts render correctly when their views are opened
Suspense fallback shown while chart chunk downloads
npm run build shows recharts chunk still exists but is lazy-loaded
userStories.notes: All 8 recharts-importing components already behind React.lazy() in SynapticRouter.tsx. No changes needed.

userStories.title: Vendor-React Chunk Audit
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the vendor-react chunk (65KB gzip) audited.
acceptanceCriteria: dist/stats.html analyzed to identify what's in vendor-react
Document whether vendor-react can be reduced or if 65KB is the floor
Remove any unnecessary packages if found
userStories.notes: Audited: react 19.2.4 + react-dom + scheduler + zustand 5.0.12 + use-sync-external-store. 65KB gzip is the floor — all essential.
